name: 🧀 Cheesy Quesadillas
what: Melty cheese quesadillas, crispy in a buttered pan, with dips.

core.name: Shredded cheese
core.out: any cheese we have, torn or grated

extras: sour cream, salsa, avocado for quick guac, black beans or chicken inside

moves.text: Pull the must-haves onto the counter. Oven to 250°F with a sheet pan inside.
Cheese on half of each tortilla, edge to edge. Fold over.
Melt a little butter in a big pan over medium. Cook 2–3 at a time, pressing down.
Finished ones go in the warm oven while you cook the rest.
Mash avocado with salt for guac. Cut into wedges and serve with dips.

key: Medium heat, not high. The cheese needs time to melt before the tortilla burns.
done: Golden on both sides and the cheese is melted all the way.
plan_b: Out of tortillas? Nachos: chips and cheese in the oven at 400°F.
